description: Local: Mako Handle Color full mode, Price Standard $ shows the Metal colours (MTL, GB block revision 2). Read-only, guarded.

args.function: async () => { const d = document.querySelector('[role=dialog][aria-label="Handle Color"]'); const b = d && d.querySelector('button[class*=closeBtn]'); if (b) b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600)); return { closed: !document.querySelector('[role=dialog][aria-label="Handle Color"]') }; }
